constraintDefinitions.name: C7_measurement_appointment_fk
constraintDefinitions.definition: FOREIGN KEY ("appointmentId", "tenantId") REFERENCES "Appointment"(id, "tenantId") ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraintDefinitions.name: C7_measurement_attempt_fk
constraintDefinitions.definition: FOREIGN KEY ("creditedAttemptId", "tenantId") REFERENCES "ActionAttempt"(id, "tenantId") ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraintDefinitions.name: C7_measurement_attribution_ck
constraintDefinitions.definition: CHECK (((("attributionStatus" IS NULL) OR ("attributionStatus" = ANY (ARRAY['NOT_APPLICABLE'::text, 'UNATTRIBUTED'::text, 'AMBIGUOUS'::text, 'ATTRIBUTED'::text]))) AND ((("creditedExecutionId" IS NULL) AND ("creditedAttemptId" IS NULL) AND (COALESCE("attributionStatus", ''::text) <> 'ATTRIBUTED'::text)) OR (("creditedExecutionId" IS NOT NULL) AND ("creditedAttemptId" IS NOT NULL) AND ("attributionStatus" = 'ATTRIBUTED'::text) AND (kind = 'appointment_outcome'::text) AND (qualification = 'VERIFIED'::text)))))

constraintDefinitions.name: C7_measurement_bounds_ck
constraintDefinitions.definition: CHECK ((((length("tenantId") >= 1) AND (length("tenantId") <= 240)) AND (octet_length(("scopeJson")::text) <= 16384) AND ((length(COALESCE(("scopeJson" ->> 'capabilityKey'::text), ''::text)) >= 1) AND (length(COALESCE(("scopeJson" ->> 'capabilityKey'::text), ''::text)) <= 100)) AND ((state = 'PENDING'::text) OR COALESCE(((((octet_length(("evidenceRefsJson")::text) + octet_length(("valuesJson")::text)) + octet_length(("limitationsJson")::text)) <= 262144) AND ((jsonb_array_length(("evidenceRefsJson" -> 'sources'::text)) + jsonb_array_length(("evidenceRefsJson" -> 'dependencies'::text))) <= 1000) AND (jsonb_array_length(("valuesJson" -> 'metrics'::text)) <= 256)), false))))

constraintDefinitions.name: C7_measurement_branch_fk
constraintDefinitions.definition: FOREIGN KEY ("branchId", "tenantId") REFERENCES "Branch"(id, "tenantId") ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraintDefinitions.name: C7_measurement_client_fk
constraintDefinitions.definition: FOREIGN KEY ("clientId", "tenantId") REFERENCES "Client"(id, "tenantId") ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraintDefinitions.name: C7_measurement_completeness_ck
constraintDefinitions.definition: CHECK (((completeness IS NULL) OR (completeness = ANY (ARRAY['COMPLETE'::text, 'PARTIAL'::text, 'UNAVAILABLE'::text, 'NOT_MEASURED'::text]))))

constraintDefinitions.name: C7_measurement_config_owner_fk
constraintDefinitions.definition: FOREIGN KEY ("configurationUserId", "tenantId") REFERENCES "Membership"("userId", "tenantId") ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraintDefinitions.name: C7_measurement_execution_fk
constraintDefinitions.definition: FOREIGN KEY ("creditedExecutionId", "tenantId") REFERENCES "ActionExecution"(id, "tenantId") ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraintDefinitions.name: C7_measurement_hashes_ck
constraintDefinitions.definition: CHECK ((("identityHash" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'::text) AND ("requestKeyHash" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'::text) AND ("intentHash" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'::text) AND (("leaseTokenHash" IS NULL) OR ("leaseTokenHash" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'::text)) AND (("evidenceHash" IS NULL) OR ("evidenceHash" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'::text)) AND (("snapshotHash" IS NULL) OR ("snapshotHash" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'::text))))

constraintDefinitions.name: C7_measurement_json_ck
constraintDefinitions.definition: CHECK (COALESCE(((jsonb_typeof("scopeJson") = 'object'::text) AND (("scopeJson" ->> 'version'::text) = '1'::text) AND (("scopeJson" - ARRAY['version'::text, 'capabilityKey'::text, 'branchIds'::text, 'dimensions'::text, 'sourceQuery'::text]) = '{}'::jsonb) AND (jsonb_typeof(("scopeJson" -> 'branchIds'::text)) = 'array'::text) AND (jsonb_typeof(("scopeJson" -> 'dimensions'::text)) = 'object'::text) AND (jsonb_typeof(("scopeJson" -> 'sourceQuery'::text)) = 'object'::text) AND ((state = 'PENDING'::text) OR ((jsonb_typeof("evidenceRefsJson") = 'object'::text) AND (("evidenceRefsJson" ->> 'version'::text) = '1'::text) AND (("evidenceRefsJson" - ARRAY['version'::text, 'sources'::text, 'dependencies'::text]) = '{}'::jsonb) AND (jsonb_typeof(("evidenceRefsJson" -> 'sources'::text)) = 'array'::text) AND (jsonb_typeof(("evidenceRefsJson" -> 'dependencies'::text)) = 'array'::text) AND (jsonb_typeof("valuesJson") = 'object'::text) AND (("valuesJson" ->> 'version'::text) = '1'::text) AND (("valuesJson" - ARRAY['version'::text, 'metrics'::text]) = '{}'::jsonb) AND (jsonb_typeof(("valuesJson" -> 'metrics'::text)) = 'array'::text) AND (jsonb_typeof("limitationsJson") = 'object'::text) AND (("limitationsJson" ->> 'version'::text) = '1'::text) AND (("limitationsJson" - ARRAY['version'::text, 'reasons'::text]) = '{}'::jsonb) AND (jsonb_typeof(("limitationsJson" -> 'reasons'::text)) = 'array'::text)))), false))

constraintDefinitions.name: C7_measurement_kind_ck
constraintDefinitions.definition: CHECK ((kind = ANY (ARRAY['appointment_outcome'::text, 'client_history'::text, 'business_period'::text, 'staff_goal'::text, 'reputation_period'::text, 'execution_funnel'::text, 'value_discrepancy'::text])))

constraintDefinitions.name: C7_measurement_lease_ck
constraintDefinitions.definition: CHECK ((((("leaseTokenHash" IS NULL) AND ("leaseExpiresAt" IS NULL)) OR (("leaseTokenHash" IS NOT NULL) AND ("leaseExpiresAt" IS NOT NULL) AND ("leaseExpiresAt" <= "expiresAt"))) AND ((state <> 'PUBLISHED'::text) OR (("leaseTokenHash" IS NULL) AND ("leaseExpiresAt" IS NULL)))))

constraintDefinitions.name: C7_measurement_period_ck
constraintDefinitions.definition: CHECK ((("periodFrom" < "periodTo") AND ("asOf" <= "admittedAt")))

constraintDefinitions.name: C7_measurement_publication_ck
constraintDefinitions.definition: CHECK ((((state = 'PENDING'::text) AND ("publishedAt" IS NULL) AND ("evidenceHash" IS NULL) AND ("snapshotHash" IS NULL) AND (completeness IS NULL) AND (qualification IS NULL) AND ("evidenceRefsJson" IS NULL) AND ("valuesJson" IS NULL) AND ("limitationsJson" IS NULL) AND ("attributionStatus" IS NULL) AND ("creditedExecutionId" IS NULL) AND ("creditedAttemptId" IS NULL)) OR ((state = 'PUBLISHED'::text) AND ("publishedAt" IS NOT NULL) AND ("publishedAt" >= "admittedAt") AND ("publishedAt" < "expiresAt") AND ("evidenceHash" IS NOT NULL) AND ("snapshotHash" IS NOT NULL) AND (completeness IS NOT NULL) AND (qualification IS NOT NULL) AND ("evidenceRefsJson" IS NOT NULL) AND ("valuesJson" IS NOT NULL) AND ("limitationsJson" IS NOT NULL) AND ("attributionStatus" IS NOT NULL))))

constraintDefinitions.name: C7_measurement_qualification_ck
constraintDefinitions.definition: CHECK (((qualification IS NULL) OR (qualification = ANY (ARRAY['VERIFIED'::text, 'SOURCE_LABELLED'::text, 'UNQUALIFIED'::text]))))

constraintDefinitions.name: C7_measurement_retention_ck
constraintDefinitions.definition: CHECK (("expiresAt" = ("admittedAt" + '8760:00:00'::interval)))

constraintDefinitions.name: C7_measurement_rule_ck
constraintDefinitions.definition: CHECK (("ruleKey" = ('c7.'::text || replace(kind, '_'::text, '-'::text))))

constraintDefinitions.name: C7_measurement_staff_fk
constraintDefinitions.definition: FOREIGN KEY ("staffId", "tenantId") REFERENCES "Staff"(id, "tenantId") ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraintDefinitions.name: C7_measurement_state_ck
constraintDefinitions.definition: CHECK ((state = ANY (ARRAY['PENDING'::text, 'PUBLISHED'::text])))

constraintDefinitions.name: C7_measurement_subject_ck
constraintDefinitions.definition: CHECK (((("appointmentId" IS NULL) OR ("clientId" IS NOT NULL)) AND ((kind <> 'appointment_outcome'::text) OR (("appointmentId" IS NOT NULL) AND ("clientId" IS NOT NULL))) AND ((kind <> 'client_history'::text) OR ("clientId" IS NOT NULL)) AND ((kind <> 'staff_goal'::text) OR (("staffId" IS NOT NULL) AND ("configurationUserId" IS NOT NULL)))))

constraintDefinitions.name: C7_measurement_tenant_fk
constraintDefinitions.definition: FOREIGN KEY ("tenantId") REFERENCES "Tenant"(id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraintDefinitions.name: C7_measurement_timezone_ck
constraintDefinitions.definition: CHECK (((length(timezone) >= 1) AND (length(timezone) <= 100)))

constraintDefinitions.name: C7_measurement_versions_ck
constraintDefinitions.definition: CHECK (((revision > 0) AND ("ruleVersion" > 0) AND ("contractVersion" > 0) AND ("leaseGeneration" >= 0)))

constraintDefinitions.name: MeasurementRevision_pkey
constraintDefinitions.definition: PRIMARY KEY (id)

indexDefinitions.definition: CREATE INDEX "C7_measurement_attempt_idx" ON public."MeasurementRevision" USING btree ("tenantId", "creditedAttemptId")

indexDefinitions.definition: CREATE INDEX "C7_measurement_client_idx" ON public."MeasurementRevision" USING btree ("tenantId", "clientId", kind, "asOf")

indexDefinitions.definition: CREATE INDEX "C7_measurement_expiry_idx" ON public."MeasurementRevision" USING btree ("expiresAt", id)

indexDefinitions.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX "C7_measurement_generation_uq" ON public."MeasurementRevision" USING btree ("tenantId", "identityHash", revision)

indexDefinitions.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX "C7_measurement_id_tenant_uq" ON public."MeasurementRevision" USING btree (id, "tenantId")

indexDefinitions.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX "C7_measurement_pending_uq" ON public."MeasurementRevision" USING btree ("tenantId", "identityHash") WHERE (state = 'PENDING'::text)

indexDefinitions.name: C7_measurement_period_idx
indexDefinitions.definition: CREATE INDEX "C7_measurement_period_idx" ON public."MeasurementRevision" USING btree ("tenantId", kind, "periodFrom", "periodTo")

indexDefinitions.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX "C7_measurement_request_uq" ON public."MeasurementRevision" USING btree ("tenantId", "requestKeyHash")

indexDefinitions.definition: CREATE INDEX "C7_measurement_staff_idx" ON public."MeasurementRevision" USING btree ("tenantId", "staffId", kind, "asOf")

indexDefinitions.name: MeasurementRevision_pkey
indexDefinitions.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX "MeasurementRevision_pkey" ON public."MeasurementRevision" USING btree (id)

triggerDefinitions.definition: CREATE TRIGGER "C7_measurement_admission_guard_trg" BEFORE INSERT ON public."MeasurementRevision" FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION "C7_measurement_admission_guard"()
